reviews.comment:
Solo sirve para cargar combustible. No tienen agua caliente en el dispensador, adentro no te la calientan porque “tienen miedo de quemarse” nos ofrecieron un enchufe para calentar el agua caliente con una pava eléctrica (que debíamos traer nosotros). Baños sucios y si tenes suerte te lavan los vidrios. Cuando pregunté la razón social de la firma no me la quisieron dar. NO ES RECOMENDABLE

(Translated by Google)
It's only good for refueling. They don't have hot water at the pump, and they won't heat it for you inside because they're "afraid of getting burned." They offered us an outlet to heat water with an electric kettle (which we had to bring ourselves). The bathrooms are dirty, and if you're lucky, they'll wash your windows. When I asked for the company's name, they refused to give it to me. NOT RECOMMENDED.
